guidebook.item1.paragraph1.en: When a child is upset, meet them emotionally first through touch and reflecting back what you're hearing.
guidebook.item1.paragraph1.id: Saat anak sedang kesal, dekati emosinya terlebih dahulu melalui sentuhan dan dengan mengulangi apa yang kamu dengar.

guidebook.item1.paragraph2.en: Once they've calmed down, you can shift to logic, problem-solving.
guidebook.item1.paragraph2.id: Setelah mereka tenang, kamu dapat beralih ke logika dan pemecahan masalah.

guidebook.item2.paragraph1.en: When emotions are overwhelming, help the child narrate what happened. Putting the experience into words engages the left brain and helps them regain a sense of control.
guidebook.item2.paragraph1.id: Saat emosi terasa berlebihan, bantu anak menceritakan apa yang terjadi. Mengungkapkan pengalaman dengan kata-kata melibatkan otak kiri dan membantu mereka kembali merasa terkendali.

guidebook.item3.paragraph1.en: In tense moments, invite the child to think and choose rather than just react. Reframe commands as questions that involve their reasoning, then praise them for coming up with alternatives.
guidebook.item3.paragraph1.id: Dalam situasi tegang, ajak anak berpikir dan memilih alih-alih hanya bereaksi. Ubah perintah menjadi pertanyaan yang melibatkan penalaran mereka, lalu puji saat mereka menemukan pilihan lain.

guidebook.item4.paragraph1.en: Treat conflict (with siblings, peers, or you) as a teaching opportunity rather than something to avoid. Giving and asking for forgiveness helps them understand what respectful relationships look like even during disagreements.
guidebook.item4.paragraph1.id: Jadikan konflik dengan saudara, teman, atau dirimu sebagai kesempatan belajar, bukan sesuatu yang harus dihindari. Memberi dan meminta maaf membantu mereka memahami hubungan yang saling menghargai meski sedang berbeda pendapat.

guidebook.item5.paragraph1.en: Read more in ‘The Whole-Brain Child’ book by Daniel J. Siegel, M.D. and Tina Payne Bryson, Ph.D.
guidebook.item5.paragraph1.id: Baca selengkapnya dalam buku ‘The Whole-Brain Child’ karya Daniel J. Siegel, M.D. dan Tina Payne Bryson, Ph.D.

gameplay.hintFallback.en: Pay attention to how each action affects the characters' feelings.
gameplay.hintFallback.id: Perhatikan bagaimana setiap tindakan memengaruhi perasaan para karakter.
